column1: Runs when the launcher starts and when the unit wakes up (ignition on). The phone must already be paired with the unit; connecting is retried for two minutes. From Android 10 only a system app (Magisk module) may switch Wi-Fi on; Android then joins saved networks itself. For wireless CarPlay the phone must have been connected through the phone app once.
column2: Jaħdem meta jibda l-launcher u meta l-unità tqum (ignition). It-telefon irid ikun diġà mqabbad mal-unità; il-konnessjoni tiġi ppruvata għal żewġ minuti. Minn Android 10, app tas-sistema biss (modulu Magisk) tista' tixgħel il-Wi-Fi; imbagħad Android jitqabbad waħdu man-netwerks issejvjati. Għal CarPlay mingħajr fili, it-telefon irid ikun tqabbad darba permezz tal-app tat-telefon.
